description: This file is a shell script that serves as a test suite for the 'git checkout --patch' functionality. It executes a series of tests using git commands and custom helper functions to verify patch application behavior, staged changes, path limiting, deletions, and edge cases like empty trees.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the supplied commands, and checks the result.

methods.name: set_and_save_state
methods.description: Sets the current state of files and saves it for comparison.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Simulates writing lines (commands) to interact with git checkout patch.

methods.name: verify_saved_state
methods.description: Verifies that the current state matches a previously saved state.

methods.name: verify_state
methods.description: Verifies the current state of specific files and their expected revision states.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches the output for specific strings, such as confirmation messages.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Sets the repository state for specific files.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Sets up cleanup commands to run after tests are executed.

methods.name: git checkout
methods.description: Performs git checkout commands with patch options.

methods.name: test_oid
methods.description: Returns object IDs, such as an empty tree hash.
